mapper.select: select * from mall_order where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update mall_order set pay_status = 1, transaction_id = #{transactionId}, paid_time = #{paidTime}, update_time = #{paidTime} where order_no = #{orderNo} and pay_status = 0 and deleted = 0
update mall_order set prepay_id = #{prepayId}, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0

update mall_order set wx_shipping_status = #{status}, wx_shipping_errcode = #{errcode}, wx_shipping_errmsg = #{errmsg}, wx_shipping_retry = #{retry}, wx_shipping_time = #{shippingTime}, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select * from mall_order where deleted = 0 and pay_status = 1 and (wx_shipping_status is null or wx_shipping_status in (0, 2)) and ifnull(wx_shipping_retry, 0) < #{maxRetry} order by paid_time asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update mall_order set pay_status = 3, pending_refund_fen = #{pendingRefundFen}, out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}, refund_reason = #{reason}, refund_by = #{refundBy}, update_by = #{refundBy}, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0 and pay_status in (1, 4)

update mall_order set refund_amount_fen = ifnull(refund_amount_fen, 0) + #{refundFen}, refund_amount = round(refund_amount_fen / 100, 2), pending_refund_fen = null, wx_refund_id = #{wxRefundId}, out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}, refund_time = #{refundTime}, pay_status = case when refund_amount_fen >= ifnull(pay_amount_fen, 0) then 5 else 4 end, update_time = #{refundTime} where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0 and ( (pay_status = 3 and out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}) or (pay_status in (1, 4) and #{allowDirect} = 1) ) and ifnull(refund_amount_fen, 0) + #{refundFen} <= ifnull(pay_amount_fen, 0)

update mall_order set pending_refund_fen = null, pay_status = case when ifnull(refund_amount_fen, 0) <= 0 then 1 when ifnull(refund_amount_fen, 0) >= ifnull(pay_amount_fen, 0) then 5 else 4 end, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and deleted = 0 and pay_status = 3 and out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo}
mapper.select: select * from mall_order where out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo} and deleted = 0 limit 1

select case when #{periodType} = 'year' then date_format(paid_time, '%Y') when #{periodType} = 'quarter' then concat(year(paid_time), '-Q', quarter(paid_time)) when #{periodType} = 'month' then date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m') else date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') end as period, count(*) as orderCount, ifnull(sum(pay_amount), 0) as payAmount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(refund_amount, 0)), 0) as refundAmount, ifnull(sum(pay_amount - ifnull(refund_amount, 0)), 0) as netAmount from mall_order where deleted = 0 and store_id = #{storeId} and paid_time is not null and paid_time >= #{startTime} and paid_time < #{endTime} and pay_status in (1, 3, 4, 5) group by 1 order by 1
